quests.title: Welcome to the village
quests.intro: Oh! A visitor. I'm Yuzu, the elder capybara. The square is safer when neighbours know each other — and when they know the train.
quests.outro: Good. Take the train from the west station when you're ready, and peek into the village hall up north.

quests.title: Explore the square
quests.intro: Walk the village loop once — past the hall door and the station platform — so you learn the lanes and lanterns.
quests.outro: You found your bearings. Porter runs the train west of the square; Pip has been collecting pebbles again.

quests.title: Pip's pebble
quests.intro: I lost my favourite smooth pebble near the notice board. Can you grab it for me?
quests.outro: Yes! That's the one. You're pretty good at finding things.

quests.title: Momo's greeting
quests.intro: The oven's warm and the square smells like cinnamon. Come say hello.
quests.outro: You're welcome at the bench any time.

quests.title: Pumpkin check
quests.intro: The meadow pumpkins need a look before the frost. Can you visit the patch?
quests.outro: They're growing nicely. Thank you for checking.

quests.title: Ruckus challenge
quests.intro: Push three crates in a row without stopping. I'll count your ruckus score!
quests.outro: Whoa, what a mess. I love it.

quests.title: Lost spectacles
quests.intro: I dropped my spectacles in the reeds. Could you find them before the minnows do?
quests.outro: Found them! I can read the river again.

quests.title: Carrot delivery
quests.intro: Hana left a carrot in the meadow. Bring it back for tomorrow's stew.
quests.outro: Perfect. The stew will be wonderful.

quests.title: Hot springs visit
quests.intro: The springs are steaming today. Come soak your paws on the east road.
quests.outro: Ahh. The water knows how to welcome travellers.

quests.title: Elder's thanks
quests.intro: You've helped everyone. One last chat by the notice board?
quests.outro: The village is lucky to have you, Mochi.

quests.title: Special delivery
quests.intro: You look quick on your paws. A parcel for Hana fell off my cart by the west lantern. Run it out to the meadow for me?
quests.outro: Hana got her seed catalogue. Check the board here each morning, I post a new job every day.

quests.title: Stake a claim
quests.intro: See that sign? South meadow plot. Flat, dry, close to home. Buy it and I'll show you how to raise a roof.
quests.outro: Ha! A landowner. Now you need somewhere to put a kettle on.

quests.title: Planks for the porch
quests.intro: I left a bundle of cedar planks at the forest edge across the north bridge. Fetch them and I'll cut you a deal on the cottage.
quests.outro: Straight grain, no knots. These will do nicely.

quests.title: Raise a roof
quests.intro: Stand on your plot, open Build, and pick the cottage. Turn it so the door faces the path. Momo's been eyeing a place of her own.
quests.outro: Look at that. Momo's already packing her flour sacks. She'll sleep there from tonight.

quests.title: Green thumbs
quests.intro: A cottage wants a garden. Beds are cheap and they earn a little every minute you're away.
quests.outro: Carrots by spring. Now, about that second plot…

quests.title: Open for business
quests.intro: The east meadow plot is going for a song. Buy it, put a market stall on it, and the whole valley will come to shop.
quests.outro: A real village now. I'll be here when you're ready for the café.

quests.title: Yard costume party
quests.intro: Boo! It's the Halloween live event! When the sky turns orange, everyone meets at your yard. Grab the candy bag by the lanterns, then say hi to Momo and Yuzu in costume!
quests.outro: You threw the best party on the block. Keep those spooky outfits!

quests.title: First train ride
quests.intro: Tickets up! Hop the train at this platform and ride out to the meadow. I'll stamp your paws when you get back.
quests.outro: Meadow stop, right on time. Come find me whenever you need another line.

quests.title: Village hall
quests.intro: The hall door faces the north square. Step inside once so you know where we gather.
quests.outro: Good. The benches are for anyone with news — or tired paws.

quests.title: Café tables
quests.intro: The café on the east square finally has tables. Come inside and say hello properly.
quests.outro: Sit any time. Cinnamon tastes better under a roof.

quests.title: Crystal ore
quests.intro: The mine mouth is open. Step inside and chip a bit of ore near the entrance for me.
quests.outro: Solid stuff. Sable will want a look at this.

quests.title: Ore for Sable
quests.intro: Take that ore down to Sable by the meadow plots. Tell him the vein's still friendly.
quests.outro: He'll sort the metal. You did the hard part.

quests.title: Rails to the springs
quests.intro: Ride the east line to the hot springs when you can. A soak quest can wait — just see the stop.
quests.outro: Steam and rails. Come back when your paws need the pool.

quests.title: Deeper light
quests.intro: I left a spare lantern deeper in the mine. Fetch it before the dark gets ideas.
quests.outro: Bright enough. Hang it near the cart next time.

quests.title: River catch
quests.intro: Cast from the river bank with Go — or near the springs pool — and bring me a silver fish.
quests.outro: Quiet paws, clean catch. The reeds will remember you.

quests.title: Baker at the café
quests.intro: Step into the café on the east square, then come say hello. I keep the pastry side warm.
quests.outro: Good. When the tray is out, grab a pastry for me.

quests.title: Warm pastry
quests.intro: I left a warm pastry on the café tray inside. Fetch it before it cools.
quests.outro: Still warm. That's the whole trick.
